name: Ballroom
_notes: Ballroom v2 - no room. Plain rimrock field, balls ride WITH the player instead of an arena: zone.follow anchors spawn/leash on the player, so ambient spawns ring you within ~60m (dice 100-400 scaled by r/400) and a ball that settles on terrain past 150m teleports back near you (airborne balls ride their arc out - leash only bites grounded). ballMix forces variant-0 (r1.2, smallest) even hosted; max4 caps the trickle for mobile. terrainPreset 5 = rimrock's palette. Spawn anchor lands you terrain-side; spawns only seed first boot, balls find you wherever you ski. Solo entry: OFFLINE > BALLS > BALLROOM, or /?mode=classic&map=ballroom.
